entities.name: Sebastian Vettel
entities.description: Born and raised in Heppenheim, Vettel began competitive kart racing aged eight. After a successful karting career—culminating in his victory at the junior European Championship in 2001—Vettel graduated to junior formulae.

entities.name: Formula BMW ADAC
entities.description: Vettel started his career in Formula BMW ADAC, dominating the championship in 2004 with 18 wins from 20 races.

entities.name: Formula 3 Euro Series
entities.description: Vettel progressed to the Formula 3 Euro Series in 2005, taking several victories and finishing runner-up to Paul di Resta the following season.
